systems.country_label: système de contrôle et d'émission de CNIB
systems.platform: duplicate search on demographic data and fingerprint biometrics, with facial biometrics added in 2009
systems.tiers: data collection centres (CCD) installed in police commissariats, intermediary data processing centres (CTID), ONI production centre

note: Undated standing page of the national police on the identity card (published date is the capture date); the civil identity system falls in no class of the typology. A lost card is declared at a commissariat, with nothing said on how the declaration is recorded.
